notes: No C++ AC in the corpus. orig.cpp follows the official editorial (SAM suffix link tree in a link/cut tree, arithmetic progression updates per run of equal last end positions); the rounds are online, so it stores suffix sums every 256 steps and adds the updates since. It matches a substring-set brute force on 1501 small gen.py cases and the generator's own offline answers (closed form minus repeated (start, length) pairs, Fenwick tree) on every seed and --max.
